{{Quote|Lord Krayt, this is ''genocide''!|[[Gial Gahan]] to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]|<ref name="Legacy 22" />}}
A '''massacre''' in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac's]] [[New Coral City/Legends|New Coral City]] occurred in [[137 ABY]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] between the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. It was the first event of the [[Genocide on Dac]].

==Prelude==
At [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was constructing an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Advanced Star Destroyer]] known as the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dru Valan]] used the newly constructed ship as bait to lure the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], led by [[Gar Stazi]] into a trap. But the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] that followed saw the theft of the ''Imperious'' and the escape of the Remnant.<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>

Following the Imperial defeat, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Darth Krayt was furious that the Alliance had escaped with the pride of his Empire's fleet. He traveled to Dac with a number of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. When he met with the [[Mon Calamari Council]], he presented the recently captured [[Gial Gahan]]. He explained that he had long known the Mon Calamari had secretly supported Stazi for the last seven years, and that he had had enough.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

Instead of punishing Gahan for betraying the Empire, Krayt ordered the execution of ten percent of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] population of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] starting with the members of the Mon Calamari Council, and the [[Genocide on Dac|internment]] of the rest in work camps.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

==The massacre==
{{Quote|Ten percent of the Mon Calamari population are to be executed. Effective immediately. We will start with the Mon Calamari at hand.|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]|<ref name="Legacy 22" />}}
[[File:DeathofGialGahan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gial Gahan is killed by Darth Krayt.]]
Immediately after Krayt issued his command, his Sith Lords, among them [[Darth Azard]], as well as his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] began to execute each Mon Calamarian present. Even though the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] had been placed in a position of power by the Sith Empire, those who opposed or questioned the Emperor's will were executed as well. With the massacre on its way, Emperor Krayt personally executed Gial Gahan.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

[[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]], two [[Imperial Knight]]s of the [[Empire-in-exile]], were in New Coral City at the time to warn Stazi of explosives they had planted aboard the ''Imperious'' prior to its capture. In the midst of the chaos, they used their [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsabers]] to cut their way through stormtroopers and rescue [[Monia Gahan]], niece of Gial Gahan and a member of the Remnant's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Gahan agreed to take them to Stazi on the condition that they rescue other Remnant pilots, who had been [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] on-world following the battle.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

The two Knights and the young Mon Calamari attacked the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in which the Rogues were held and quickly managed to rescue the prisoners, among them the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]]. When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Darth Azard]] confronted them, Sinde confronted him and managed to draw the Quarren's attention away from his escaping comrades. An explosion courtesy of Ronto stopped the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] and allowed Master Sinde to escape.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

==Aftermath==
Dare, Gahan, Ronto, and the rest of the pilots reached Admiral Stazi. Meanwhile, Master Sinde went underground, joining a [[Mon Calamari Rangers|resistance cell]] of Mon Calamari freedom fighters formed against the Sith Empire's [[Speciecide|genocidal]] oppression.<ref name="Legacy 22" />

==Behind the scenes==
The order by Krayt to destroy 10% of the Mon Calamari may be a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Roman Empire|Roman Empire's]] practice of punishing mutiny or cowardice by [[Wikipedia:Decimation (Roman army)|decimation]], which translates literally as ''removal of one-tenth''.
